query:
SELECT t.id, t.token, t.userId, t.expiresAt, t.used, t.createdAt, u.email 
FROM passwordResetTokens t 
JOIN users u ON t.userId = u.id 
WHERE u.email = 'testadmin@example.com' 
ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1
